classification.difficultyReason: Apply the standard origin-centred circle equation, taking exact square roots and labelling intercepts.

content.prompt: Sketch these circles showing the centre and all intercepts.

answer.short: Circle with centre $(0,0)$ and radius $7$; intercepts $(\pm7,0)$ and $(0,\pm7)$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}r^2&=49\\r&=7\end{aligned}$$
Sketch a circle centred at $(0,0)$ through $(7,0)$, $(-7,0)$, $(0,7)$ and $(0,-7)$.
